highlights: Special Feature   Robotic Design, TFT Fun Display, Pocket Size, Built In Cable, Fast Charging
30W Two-Way Fast Charging: This 10000 mAh battery bank supports up to 30W fast charging that can quickly refuel your iPhone 15 0-60% in 30 mins, dramatically reducing tedious waiting times

Clear TFT digital display: This fast charging portable charger is also equipped with a TFT display, through vivid and interesting expressions, you can clearly know the remaining battery power, so you don't have to guess when to charge

Small Size, Big Power: This thin and light battery pack measures just 4.5 x 2.7 x 0.7 inches, has a 10,000mAh capacity and can fully charge an iPhone 15 Pro more than 2 times, keeping your device powered for hours

Integrated Design: Ugreen portable charger has a built-in 1.6 ft usb c charging cable, which makes charging more convenient, it also has a USB-A and USB-C interface, which can power 3 devices simultaneously, maximizing productivity

Wide Compatibility: USB c power bank is compatible with almost all popular mobile phones or tablets, such as iPhone 16/15/14/13/12/11 series, Samsung S24/S23/A52/A32/Z Fold series Z Flip series, Google Pixel series and other Android phones and tablets, etc
